subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 official action-pin updates land as one grouped security-sensitive change after fresh representative workflow proof, or should the token, Docker release, and Codex updates be split for separate approval?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it changes executable dependencies across multiple secret-bearing and publishing boundaries; repository policy and the protected security label require a human to accept that grouped blast radius.

options.title: Validate and land grouped
options.body: Rebase the PR, complete direct Codex-source review, and run representative workflow proof for each sensitive action family before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate token minting, Docker publishing, Codex agent, and ordinary setup/scanning actions so each security boundary can be reviewed and proven independently.

options.title: Defer the refresh
options.body: Keep the current pins until the repository can obtain stable current-head proof for the affected workflow families.

recommendation.title: Validate and land grouped
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, complete direct Codex-source review, and run representative workflow proof for each sensitive action family before merging the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the broad CI, Docker action-runtime, and docs-agent surfaces affected by the grouped update.
